name: derby-cli
description: Derby File Storage command line client
author: Steven Day

scripts.build:binaries: bun build --compile src/cli.ts --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/bin/derby-macos-arm64 && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/bin/derby-macos-x64 && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/bin/derby-linux-x64 && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/bin/derby-windows-x64.exe
